test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
On all the five corners of pentagon, five people Ram, Rohan, Sunita, Seema and Chandan sit in a specific order facing towards the centre. Ram is to the immediate left of Rohan. Sunita is not an immediate neighbour of Ram. Chandan is an immediate neighbour of both Sunita and Seema.

What will be the position of Sunita with respect to Ram?

options.text: Sunita occupies second place from Ram in the clockwise direction
Sunita occupies third place from Ram in the anticlockwise direction
Sunita occupies first place from Ram in the anti-clockwise direction
Sunita occupies third place from Ram in the clockwise direction

solution:
**__EXPLANATION:__**

1. Ram is to the immediate left of Rohan. 

2. Sunita is not an immediate neighbour of Ram. 

** __Case1__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e5401fe03f2f126ddfbd6448f8708fe620d759d3c61cedebb4c50cba4c2a7e6.png] 

 

 __** Case2 **__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/233e3c0c1972183e00bfc69534a726dd8948273c927578cd9a017a34dd1971c2.png] 

3. Chandan is an immediate neighbour of both Sunita and Seema. So case 2 gets cancelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e85e6d67ff776830ed650b77198ca7a4437a832b4822232c370301dcc21ee9cd.png] 

 

Hence** "Sunita occupies third place from Ram in the clockwise direction" **is the correct answer.
